editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: vercel-labs/skills
items.summary: Developed by Vercel Labs, skills is an open-source skills tool for AI agents. This structure, which developers can quickly access via the npx command, aims to standardize functionality in agent-based applications.

items.title: xtool-org/xtool
items.summary: xtool is a cross-platform Xcode alternative that allows you to compile and distribute iOS applications on Linux, Windows, and macOS using the Swift Package Manager (SwiftPM). It eliminates dependency on Apple's development environment, Xcode, and supports the application development process on different operating systems.

items.title: GLM-Legal
items.summary: GLM-Legal is a large language model developed to analyze and process texts in the field of law. It offers specialized capabilities for understanding legal documents and managing legal processes.

items.title: AI is a tool and using it well takes skill
items.summary: The effective use of artificial intelligence as a tool depends on the skills possessed by the users. This technology requires a competency that can increase productivity when applied with the right methods.

items.title: 11 year old unsoundness bugs found in Rust borrow checker
items.summary: Unsoundness issues that have existed for 11 years have been detected in the borrow checker, which ensures memory safety in the Rust programming language. This situation indicates that some code structures that the compiler considers safe can actually lead to memory errors.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon, developed by Google, has been announced as the company's latest large language model. This model offers new capabilities in text and multimodal data processing workflows.

items.title: Apple HomeView
items.summary: Apple HomeView is an interface offered by Apple that allows for the management of smart home devices from a central point. It enables users to control connected devices in their homes from a single screen.

items.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
items.summary: UNITAS is a world action model that simulates physical movements and their environmental effects in three-dimensional space for robotic manipulation tasks. Unlike traditional video-based approaches, it aims to process robotic interactions more consistently by using metric three-dimensional data instead of visual projections.

items.title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Vision-language models are being trained to produce structured outputs such as coordinates or bounding boxes for robots and interfaces. This study systematically examines the safety alignment of these output channels across three different benchmarks.

items.title: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
items.summary: Prospective Hindsight introduces a self-calibrating reinforcement learning training principle for AI agents performing long-term tasks. The method improves the training process by leveraging the difference between the agent's pre-action prediction and post-action evaluation.

items.title: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance
items.summary: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance proposes a method based on long-tail performance in reference input-output distributions to measure the creativity of large language models (LLMs). This approach offers a new evaluation framework that combines novelty and quality to address discrepancies in creativity benchmarks.

items.title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score
items.summary: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score, examines how benchmark scores are influenced more by reference selection than by system output. The study, conducted on a six-language dataset, shows that changing the reference can alter performance scores by as much as 4.95 F-score.

Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.

An artificial intelligence model with comprehensive language capability, trained to understand and process texts in specific fields such as law.
